title: Digital Banks - Worldwide
highlights: In the Digital Banks market market, the projected Net Interest Income worldwide is set to reach US$1.66tn in 2026.
Looking ahead, it is expected that the Net Interest Income will display an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2030) of 7.29%, leading to a market volume of US$2.20tn by 2030.
When compared globally, China is expected to generate the highest Net Interest Income, amounting to US$562.7bn in 2026.
Digital banks in the worldwide banking market are rapidly gaining popularity, with countries like the United Kingdom leading the way in terms of adoption and innovation.
